observations: Darker backgrounds print better than white

configuration.method: Randoma11y source RGB pairs: dark member for ground, light member for type and groundstation marks and fiber links. Fiber links use full stroke opacity. Orbital markers and their legend keys retain the original vendor/group colors. Land is a 16% foreground blend into the ground; muted context is a 68% blend. Black debris x marks retain a light halo. No ink compensation or six-channel separation is simulated.
configuration.calibration: Unmeasured visual hypotheses; parameters are not estimates of ink loss or paper response.
